title: Adult Homo erectus fossil confirms species appeared in Africa 2 million years ago
summary_full: Researchers have described 18 previously unpublished hominin fossils from South Africa, including an adultHomo erectusfossil dated to 2 million years ago. The findings support the species’ first appearance in southern Africa at that time and provide evidence of microevolution inP. robustus.
